description: What money can pay for, in rough estimates for one person, in today's euros. 'live' items are monthly costs, derived from the home country's living costs in cost-of-living.json. 'buy' items are one-off amounts: a published average, a calculation from published figures (see calc), or months of living costs from cost-of-living.json (see monthsAt). Estimates, not live data, not advice.

conversion.note: USD figures converted at the rate used in cost-of-living.json.

live.name: Pay your rent
live.source: Average rent of a 1-bedroom flat outside the centre in your country (Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

live.name: Work 4 days a week
live.source: One day in five of your country's monthly living costs (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json): the income a fifth working day replaces.

live.name: Work half-time
live.source: Half of your country's monthly living costs (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

live.name: Stop working
live.source: All of your country's monthly living costs for one person (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: An e-bike
buy.source: RAI Vereniging and BOVAG (NielsenIQ): average price of an e-bike sold in the Netherlands in 2025, published February 2026.

buy.name: A driving licence
buy.source: CBR: average total cost of a Dutch B licence in 2025 (41 lessons, theory and practical exams), published March 2026.

buy.name: Solar panels for your roof
buy.source: Milieu Centraal: average price of 10 solar panels installed in the Netherlands.

buy.name: A hybrid heat pump
buy.source: Milieu Centraal: 4 kW hybrid heat pump with installation and VAT, before subsidy (about EUR 2,125 back).

buy.name: Three months living in Japan
buy.source: 3 months of Japan's living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A year travelling Southeast Asia
buy.source: 12 months at the average living cost with rent of Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: Six months living in Portugal
buy.source: 6 months of Portugal's living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: Six months of your costs set aside
buy.source: 6 months of your country's living costs (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A new kitchen
buy.source: Homedeal: average price of a standard kitchen with appliances and installation in the Netherlands (range EUR 7,000 to 25,000).

buy.name: Paying off an average student debt
buy.source: DUO: average student debt in the Netherlands at the start of 2025 (median EUR 10,300).

buy.name: A wedding
buy.source: ThePerfectWedding.nl: average cost of a Dutch wedding without the honeymoon.

buy.name: A used car
buy.source: AutoScout24 occasion dashboard: average asking price of a used car in the Netherlands in 2025.

buy.name: A year off
buy.source: 12 months of your country's living costs (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A master's year in the Netherlands
buy.source: Statutory tuition fee 2025-2026 of EUR 2,601 (Rijksoverheid) plus 12 months of Dutch living costs with rent (Numbeo + Wise, via cost-of-living.json).

buy.name: A used electric car
buy.source: AutoScout24 occasion dashboard: average asking price of a used electric car in the Netherlands in 2025.

buy.name: A 10% deposit on a Dutch home
buy.source: 10% of the average price of an existing home in the Netherlands in 2025, EUR 480,000 (CBS, published February 2026).

buy.name: A new car
buy.source: RAI Vereniging: average price of a new car sold in the Netherlands in 2025 (NL Times, August 2025).

buy.name: Taking over a small business
buy.source: Your own 35% of a EUR 200,000 price: small Dutch businesses often sell for about 4 times yearly profit (here EUR 50,000), and banks usually lend 60-70% (Brookz, Inter Actus).

buy.name: An 80 m² flat in upscale Lima, Peru
buy.source: BCRP (Banco Central de Reserva del Perú): average asking price of flats in the districts its housing-price index covers, well-off areas such as Miraflores, San Isidro and Santiago de Surco, not all of Lima: USD 1,868 per m² in Q4 2025, published March 2026.

buy.name: An 80 m² flat in Portugal
buy.source: INE Portugal: median bank valuation of flats in 2025, EUR 2,239 per m².

buy.name: An average Dutch home, fully paid
buy.source: CBS: average price of an existing owner-occupied home in the Netherlands in 2025, published February 2026.
